Text.Text: Finally, a test with a clean ending. I can rebuild the charge model with readings I trust. You've finished my Overload Barrage trials. I have no further work for you here.
I need rank 50 in Devices for these tests. Reach that rank and come back; this rig needs an operator who understands it.

Someone at the Qion site is falsifying charge tables. Bring me their test log before I trust another reading from the range. Defeat six Overload Barrage Adepts in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Overload Barrage Qion Test Log; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon, Fort Ka'ra. I'll give you the Hutlar Qion Test Site Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Overload Barrage.

Here's the Hutlar Qion Test Site Key. Use 'Qion Test Site' in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Overload Barrage Adepts, then return with the Overload Barrage Qion Test Log.
Every reading off that site's test range is inflated, spiked, wrong in a way that's consistent, which is worse than random-wrong. Consistent-wrong means someone's doing it on purpose.

Dump every cell you're carrying in one commit, all at once, no stagger, and you'd better have the discharge math right or you slag your own rig doing it. Done properly it ends a fight in one motion. Done badly it ends you.
Whose charge tables they're running, how far off my originals they've drifted, and hopefully not my own handwriting on the cover, because that would really ruin my week.
Defeat six Overload Barrage Adepts in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Overload Barrage Qion Test Log; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon, Fort Ka'ra.
You've defeated six Overload Barrage Adepts. Let me see the Overload Barrage Qion Test Log.
Now I have a record of their modifications. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are pushing the cold-weather regulator past its limits. Recover it before the charge tables get worse. Defeat five Overload Barrage Specialists in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Overload Barrage Cryo-Range Regulator; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon, Fort Ka'ra.
Your key still grants access to Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Defeat five Overload Barrage Specialists to secure the Overload Barrage Cryo-Range Regulator, then return to me.
Log tells me what they stole. Regulator tells me what they've been doing with it since, which is the part that actually costs someone their arm.
Bad enough that a barrage run off it either fizzles at half power or overshoots and cooks the caster. No middle setting. I built in a middle setting. They removed it.
Rebuild the safety curve they stripped out, then quietly make sure nobody at that site gets their hands on my tables again. Quietly is generous. Loudly, probably.
Defeat five Overload Barrage Specialists in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Overload Barrage Cryo-Range Regulator; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon, Fort Ka'ra.
You've defeated five Overload Barrage Specialists. Let me see the Overload Barrage Cryo-Range Regulator.
I'll inspect this before anything goes back into service. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden protects the site's unsafe firing program. Bring back the test crest. Defeat the Overload Barrage Warden in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Overload Barrage Frostburned Test Crest; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon, Fort Ka'ra. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Hutlar, Qion Test Site, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Overload Barrage Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Overload Barrage Frostburned Test Crest.
He's routing barrage discharge back through his own field before it lands, which shouldn't work, and yet here we are. Someone taught him that, and it wasn't me, which bothers me more than it should.
Frostburn scoring tells me the field's overloading at a specific threshold. Get me the crest and I can calculate that threshold instead of guessing at it.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Overload Barrage Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Overload Barrage Warden in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Overload Barrage Frostburned Test Crest; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon, Fort Ka'ra. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Overload Barrage Warden. Let me see the Overload Barrage Frostburned Test Crest.
That confirms who was in charge of the unsafe work. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four senior operators still authorize those loads. Take their override chip. Defeat four members of the Overload Barrage Inner Circle in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Overload Barrage Site Chief's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon, Fort Ka'ra.
Your key still grants access to Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Defeat four members of the Overload Barrage Inner Circle to secure the Overload Barrage Site Chief's Override Chip, then return to me.
Every override authorization, timestamped, with a signature I'm hoping I don't recognize. Spoiler: I probably will.
Whoever's clean enough on paper to sign off and dirty enough in practice to want my tables stolen. That's not a person, that's a job description, and I'm about to learn who's filling it.
Four together beats one warden, in some ways. Bring backup, less because the math demands it and more because I'd rather not explain to anyone why I sent you in short-handed.

Defeat four members of the Overload Barrage Inner Circle in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Overload Barrage Site Chief's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon, Fort Ka'ra.
You've defeated four members of the Overload Barrage Inner Circle. Let me see the Overload Barrage Site Chief's Override Chip.
No more unauthorized orders from that crew. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master is running the final barrage trial. Defeat him in the Overload Chamber so I can finish the diagnostic. Defeat the Overload Barrage Master in Hutlar, Overload Chamber. Report back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon, Fort Ka'ra; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Hutlar, Overload Chamber, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Overload Barrage Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

Warden borrowed a shield trick. He's not borrowing anything, he's running the barrage exactly the way I designed it before I added the safeties back in. Full discharge, no stagger, no mercy in the math.
Same way anyone gets something they shouldn't: somebody I trusted handed them over. I don't like thinking about who. I like it less every day this drags on.
Then Overload Barrage is yours, properly, with the safeties I built back in and none of the ones he stripped out. I'd rather it belong to someone who counts the cost first.

Defeat the Overload Barrage Master in Hutlar, Overload Chamber. Report back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon, Fort Ka'ra; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Overload Barrage Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
Finally, a test with a clean ending. I can rebuild the charge model with readings I trust. You've earned the right to train Overload Barrage. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the numbers.
I'll defeat six Overload Barrage Adepts.
What's actually wrong with your board?
What is an overload barrage supposed to do?
What will the log tell you?
I've got somewhere to be first.
Here's the Overload Barrage Qion Test Log.
Back to the numbers.
I'll defeat five Overload Barrage Specialists.
Why does the regulator matter more than the log?
How bad is the corrupted math, really?
What will you do once you have it?
Not today.
Here's the Overload Barrage Cryo-Range Regulator.
Back to the numbers.
I'll defeat the Overload Barrage Warden.
What's this shielding trick doing exactly?
What does the crest prove?
Would you recommend bringing help?
Let me find people first.
Here's the Overload Barrage Frostburned Test Crest.
Back to the numbers.
I'll defeat four members of the Overload Barrage Inner Circle.
What's recorded on that chip?
Who's the site chief, exactly?
Same numbers as the warden fight?
Give me a moment.
Here's the Overload Barrage Site Chief's Override Chip.
Back to the numbers.
I'll face the Overload Barrage Master and report back.
How is he stronger than the warden?
How did he get your original tables?
What happens to Overload Barrage after this?
I need to think about this fight.
The Overload Barrage Master is defeated. Here's my report.
